item.title: UK prime minister calls actions of Russian warship reckless but not sinister
item.description: UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer says the crew of a Russian warship of acted recklessly in firing a warning shots near a British yacht in the English Channel

item.title: Sudan’s young women return to international soccer as war and taboos linger
item.description: Sudan's under-17 women's national soccer team has made its first international appearance since civil war erupted in the country

item.title: UK military investigates after Russian warship fires warning shots near yacht in the Channel
item.description: A Russian warship has fired warning shots near a U.K.-registered pleasure yacht in the English Channel

item.title: Whale 'supergroups' show numbers are rebounding from hunting. But Iran war holds dangers for them
item.description: A renowned wildlife photographer says he and his wife documented the rare sight of around 300 humpback whales coming together off the coast of South Africa in what's known as a whale “supergroup.”

item.title: Ukrainian attacks on holiday camps in partly Russian-occupied Zaporizhzhia kill 11
item.description: Relentless cycle of tit-for-tat attacks dims hopes for a diplomatic end to war.

item.title: Brazil's government denies visas to US officials over upcoming elections
item.description: Brazil’s Foreign Ministry says it denied visas to two U.S. State Department officials that sought to travel to the South American nation next week

item.title: France's D-Day landing beaches, Greece's Mount Olympus added to World Heritage List
item.description: World War II’s D-Day landing beaches in northern France and the iconic Mount Olympus in Greece were among the sites added to the World Heritage List on Sunday at a U.N. committee meeting in South Korea reviewing dozens of nominations
